verdict.rationale: Reducto's enterprise deployment docs offer a dedicated VPC deployment alongside a hybrid VPC model, under an on-prem docs section (reducto-docs-40). That covers running the stack inside the customer's own infrastructure. The hybrid option keeps data and storage in the customer VPC but still sends ephemeral processing to Reducto's GPU infrastructure (reducto-docs-15), so only the dedicated option fully keeps documents in-house. Missing for 10: detailed setup and requirements docs for the dedicated VPC or fully on-prem deployment, explicit air-gapped or fully self-hosted confirmation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
